facts.interpretation: At most five review records in one Places (New) response; fewer are possible.
This endpoint documents relevance ordering, not uniform random sampling.
The aggregate count includes ratings with and without written comments.
A separate aggregate rating exists; do not recompute it from five excerpts.
Maximum requested page size; this is not a 50-review cap for the entire location.
Use returned continuation tokens to request later pages.
The review-list operation requires a verified location and appropriate authorization.
The documented default orders by most recently modified, not necessarily most recently created.
The response separates aggregate count/rating from review records and pagination.
Review creation and latest modification are distinct fields.
Delay, profile changes and policy enforcement can affect visibility; widget absence is not a removal verdict.
API availability does not grant unrestricted retention or republication of review content.
